title: Core Academic & Identity Bundle (5 Docs)
description: Essential foundation requirements required for initial university evaluation.

items.title: Passport Copy (Information Page)
items.instruction: Upload high-quality color scanned copy of valid international Passport (Information & signature page).

items.title: Academic Transcripts & Certificates
items.instruction: Upload official verified scanned copies of academic degree certificates and all marksheets.

items.title: English Language Proficiency (IELTS / PTE / MOI)
items.instruction: Upload valid official score report (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL) or English Medium of Instruction certificate.

items.title: Statement of Purpose (SOP)
items.instruction: Upload detailed personal statement explaining academic motivation, university selection, and career goals.

items.title: Letters of Recommendation (LOR - 2 Copies)
items.instruction: Upload 2 signed recommendation letters from university professors or current professional employer.

title: Standard Admission & Solvency Pack (7 Docs)
description: Standard comprehensive bundle with 6-month financial verification.

items.title: Passport Copy (Information Page)
items.instruction: Upload high-quality color scanned copy of valid international Passport.

items.title: Academic Transcripts & Certificates
items.instruction: Upload official verified scanned copies of degree and transcripts.

items.title: English Language Proficiency (IELTS / PTE / MOI)
items.instruction: Upload valid English language proficiency scorecard.

items.title: Statement of Purpose (SOP)
items.instruction: Upload personal statement tailored for program admission.

items.title: Letters of Recommendation (LOR - 2 Copies)
items.instruction: Upload 2 signed recommendation letters.

items.title: Bank Solvency Certificate & 6-Month Statement
items.instruction: Upload official bank solvency certificate with minimum 6 months history showing continuous balance.

items.title: Police Clearance Certificate (PCC)
items.instruction: Upload government-issued official police clearance certificate (issued within last 6 months).

title: Complete Visa & Embassy Dossier (9 Docs)
description: Full dossier containing medical, financial, identity, and background documentation.

items.title: Passport Copy (Information Page)
items.instruction: Upload high-quality color scanned copy of valid international Passport.

items.title: Academic Transcripts & Certificates
items.instruction: Upload official verified scanned copies of degree and marksheets.

items.title: English Language Proficiency (IELTS / PTE / MOI)
items.instruction: Upload valid English test scorecard (IELTS/PTE).

items.title: Statement of Purpose (SOP)
items.instruction: Upload comprehensive academic Statement of Purpose.

items.title: Letters of Recommendation (LOR - 2 Copies)
items.instruction: Upload 2 signed reference letters.

items.title: Bank Solvency Certificate & 6-Month Statement
items.instruction: Upload bank solvency certificate and verified 6 months bank statement.

items.title: Police Clearance Certificate (PCC)
items.instruction: Upload official police verification certificate.

items.title: Medical Fitness & Vaccination Certificate
items.instruction: Upload certified health examination report and TB/vaccine clearance certificate.

items.title: Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV / Resume)
items.instruction: Upload professional resume formatted for embassy and admission review.

title: UK Student Route (CAS & Visa Pack)
description: Required checklist for UK universities and UKVI visa appointment.

items.title: Valid International Passport
items.instruction: Upload color scan of passport with at least 6 months validity.

items.title: Official CAS Statement Copy
items.instruction: Upload formal Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies issued by UK university.

items.title: UKVI Academic Transcripts & Degrees
items.instruction: Upload all academic transcripts referenced in your CAS letter.

items.title: IELTS for UKVI or SELT Scorecard
items.instruction: Upload official SELT certificate showing CEFR B2 level proficiency.

items.title: 28-Day Financial Bank Statement
items.instruction: Upload 28-day continuous funds statement covering tuition + UK maintenance.

items.title: Tuberculosis (TB) Test Certificate (IOM)
items.instruction: Upload TB test report issued by an approved IOM diagnostic center.

items.title: Consent Letter & Birth Certificate (If Sponsored)
items.instruction: If using parental funds, upload sponsor affidavit and official birth certificate.

title: Canada Study Permit (SDS & PAL Pack)
description: Complete requirements for IRCC Canadian student visa filing.

items.title: Valid International Passport
items.instruction: Upload clear bio-data pages of international passport.

items.title: DLI Letter of Acceptance (LOA)
items.instruction: Upload official unconditional acceptance letter from designated learning institution.

items.title: Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL)
items.instruction: Upload government-issued provincial attestation letter (PAL).

items.title: Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC)
items.instruction: Upload GIC proof of purchase ($20,635 CAD) from approved Canadian financial institution.

items.title: First-Year Tuition Fee Payment Receipt
items.instruction: Upload official wire transfer receipt confirming full 1st year tuition payment.

items.title: Upfront eMedical Examination Sheet
items.instruction: Upload information sheet provided by panel physician after medical exam.

items.title: Police Clearance Certificate
items.instruction: Upload police clearance certificate issued within the past 6 months.
